items.title: Nerdulator – put something in, get everything out (no AI)

items.title: Are requests/demands coming from AI companies for regulation genuine?
items.raw_excerpt: Lately I have been hearing a lot of people from AI companies asking for regulation and expressing fear on AI's capabilities. Are these genuine, or do they now realize that there is a financial bubble and they are trying to deflate it a bit? It seems that it is too late for regulation to kick in. It has to be an international body and it will take forever to come to a consensus and give this body some teeth. On the other hand, if the growth is exponential, it is not surprising that you notice too late to do anything substantial. How can we tell if these requests are genuine or not? I am inclined to think that they are, after listening to the CNN interview; but it sounds so strange.

items.title: The AI Language We Can't Read: Neuralese [video]
items.raw_excerpt: This video explores the idea of "Neuralese"—internal representations or communication patterns in AI models that humans cannot directly read. It discusses the interpretability challenge: when a model's internal states no longer map onto natural language, understanding its reasoning and intent becomes far harder, raising alignment and safety concerns.

title_i18n.en: The AI Language We Can't Read: Neuralese [video]
title_i18n.zh: 我们无法解读的AI语言：神经语【视频】
title_i18n.es: El lenguaje de la IA que no podemos leer: Neuralese [vídeo]

excerpt_i18n.en: This video explores the idea of "Neuralese"—internal representations or communication patterns in AI models that humans cannot directly read. It discusses the interpretability challenge: when a model's internal states no longer map onto natural language, understanding its reasoning and intent becomes far harder, raising alignment and safety concerns.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该视频围绕“神经语”（Neuralese）这一概念展开，讨论人工智能模型内部可能形成的、人类难以直接解读的表征与通信方式。内容涉及可解释性研究的挑战：当模型的内部状态不再对应自然语言时，理解其推理过程与意图会变得更加困难，并可能带来对齐与安全方面的隐忧。

items.title: Your Agent Aced the Task. Will It Do It Again?
items.raw_excerpt: The post examines AI agent reliability: an agent that aces a task once may not reproduce that success on repeated runs. IBM Research's ALTK Evolve work argues that consistency and repeatability should be measured alongside single-run task success to better reflect real-world usability.

title_i18n.en: Your Agent Aced the Task. Will It Do It Again?
title_i18n.zh: 你的 Agent 出色完成了任务。它还能再来一次吗？
title_i18n.es: Tu agente bordó la tarea. ¿Volverá a hacerlo?

excerpt_i18n.en: The post examines AI agent reliability: an agent that aces a task once may not reproduce that success on repeated runs. IBM Research's ALTK Evolve work argues that consistency and repeatability should be measured alongside single-run task success to better reflect real-world usability.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 该文章聚焦 AI 智能体的可靠性问题：智能体在一次评测中顺利完成任务，并不意味着重复执行时仍能稳定复现同样的结果。IBM Research 在 Hugging Face 博客中介绍了 ALTK Evolve 相关工作，主张在单次任务成功率之外，把一致性、可重复性作为评估智能体能力的关键指标，以更真实地反映其在生产环境中的可用性。
